set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: Q01.3
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend engineer with scientist and operator
Scope: Establish the actual supported limits instead of reporting development timings as an SLA.

Work kind: mixed
Acceptance gate: Q01 (bd-01M4W40KZWFPTRA33A443C4DM8)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Run representative correctness/load scenarios on the selected staging hardware, including large individual files, many files and repeated revisions.
2. Meet SITE01 targets or obtain an explicit narrower accepted scope; required correctness/authority failures cannot be waived for speed, and unresolved failures receive blocking remediation motes.
3. Publish measured import/file/history/concurrency limits, resource settings and raw results; record whether original PRD targets remain outstanding.

Verification: Accepted capacity/support report, raw benchmark evidence and a zero-open-blocker check for required scenarios.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/Q01.3/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

External inputs:
- Selected staging hardware
- Operator/curator acceptance of measured scope

Source/contracts:
- docs/evidence/query-scale-summary.json
- docs/prd.md
- modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/DurableImports.scala
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md

Blocked by:
- Q01.1: bd-01M4W5PBPX2HCJAENHXPF7014T
- Q01.2: bd-01M4W5PBV2N5ECB8WMAYB689B6
- W01: bd-01M4W40KKEG53SX6WJ17NQVQSV
- W02: bd-01M4W40KPVEFQSMWFEDZZC69SW
- O02: bd-01M4W40K6BGH2A78J8820FP8M6
- H04.2: bd-01M4X8MAYAJRT50TKYR5JCP7R4
- SITE01.3: bd-01M4W5P4DYBM03CDGZ6AGB9DVP

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
